title: Cocycle Actions on Hidden Quantum Markov Models: Symmetry Protection and Topological Order
summary: We develop a symmetry action framework for hidden quantum Markov models (HQMMs) tailored to one-dimensional quantum spin systems and symmetry-protected topological (SPT) phases. In our setting, a symmetry group $G$ acts projectively on the hidden (virtual) degrees of freedom and linearly on the physical observation space, yielding a global HQMM state that is invariant under the combined action of $G$ for both conventional and causal (input--output) structures.
